Six styles, one script

Each tab is the same 16-second explainer in a different style, laid out as the storyboard a real run would show you: four scenes, each with its frame, narration, timing and style notes. The last scene shows how the style handles Egyptian Arabic, right to left. Press Play to watch the rough animatic with the Kokoro bf_emma narration. Then pick a style or blend parts of several, and save. The seventh tab, Your blend, is the saved pick: the Claude Code layout with the ITWorx deck palette.
